text:
olivia_docs: PR #4602 ready — fixes SDK examples and adds migration checklist. Preview URL is up but asset map mismatch caused one example widget to 500. Need a reviewer and a merge slot for tomorrow 06:15 UTC. preview: https://preview-4602--redwood-docs.vercel.app :wave:

ci-bot: Build finished. Runtime error on /examples/widget: TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'init') — stack: https://ci-logs.example/4602

sara_eng: I'll take a quick look. Can you paste the snippet for widget init? Sometimes we assume a global that the preview runner strips.

olivia_docs: snippet: `const w = new Widget({apiKey: "<KEY>"}); await w.init();` I updated docs to show `await import('widget-sdk').then(m=>m.init(...))` in the PR but the preview still references the old bundle in one include.

dan_platform: common issue: some includes are cached in the build cache. Try `mkdocs build --clean` locally and run `grep -R "Widget(" site || true` to find stale references.

olivia_docs: did that locally, I found an include in docs/includes/legacy-widget.html still referencing the old init. Pushing a fix to replace it with the dynamic import. Triggering redeploy.

preview-bot: Redeploy triggered for preview-4602. URL: https://preview-4602--redwood-docs.vercel.app/examples/widget/ :hourglass_flowing_sand:

ci-bot: Deploy succeeded; all routes 200. Also: FYI, previews run under a stricter CSP and block inline eval; avoid using eval in examples.

sara_eng: reviewed the code changes — LGTM. small nit: add a short note about dynamic import patterns in the migration checklist.

dan_platform: infra OK. Approved. Merge slot 06:15 UTC is fine. SRE will watch the staging deploy if you merge then.

olivia_docs: thanks — I'll queue the merge at 06:15 UTC and post here once merged. Adding local repro steps in the PR description: `git fetch origin pull/4602/head:pr-4602 && git checkout pr-4602 && pip install -r requirements.txt && mkdocs build --clean && python -m http.server --directory site 8000`

ci-bot: Reminder: comment `ci-bot: abort deploy` within 10 minutes after merge to cancel prod deploy if needed.

olivia_docs: merging at slot now. pinging after merge.
